{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nar Hej Shipping Company''' was a shipping company that had a base of operations on [[Napdu]]. [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] was redirected there by [[Bardan Jusik]] to keep them off of [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai's]] trail.
